name: Dragonmaw War Banner
summary: Dragonmaw War Banners rise over orc encampments in the Wetlands. Their clan markings give the dwarven defenders of Menethil Harbor proof of the growing threat.

sections.title: Emblems of an Enduring Threat
sections.body: After the Second War, the Dragonmaw clan was shattered when they lost control of their enslaved red dragons. The enraged drakes turned on their captors and drove the survivors from Grim Batol into the eastern hills. Now the remaining orcs gather strength under Chieftain Nek'rosh and raise their banners over camps northeast of Menethil Harbor. Those rough standards mark their defiance and threaten the settlements in the marsh.

sections.title: Proof of Conquest
sections.body: Captain Stoutfist at Menethil Harbor sends Alliance adventurers into the marsh camps to bring back Dragonmaw banners. Raiders, centurions, and bone-warders carry these trophies, which confirm to the dwarven garrison that the camps are being broken before the clan can launch coordinated raids.

faq.q: Why does Captain Stoutfist want these banners?
faq.answer: Captain Stoutfist wants the banners as proof that adventurers have struck the Dragonmaw camp northeast of Menethil Harbor and thinned its ranks.

faq.q: Who carries the Dragonmaw War Banners?
faq.answer: Dragonmaw raiders, swamprunners, centurions, battlemasters, shadowwarders, bonewarders, and Chieftain Nek'rosh carry the banners in their Wetlands camps.

faq.q: Why are the Dragonmaw orcs in the Wetlands?
faq.answer: Near the end of the Second War, the Dragonmaw lost control of their captive red dragons. The freed dragons hunted their former masters, forcing the surviving orcs to flee Grim Batol and scatter into the eastern hills, the wetlands, and the surrounding mountains.

faq.q: Who leads the Dragonmaw clan now?
faq.answer: Chieftain Nek'rosh leads the clan. He is the son of its former chieftain, Nekros, and has sworn vengeance against the red dragons who turned on and killed his father.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Khaz Modan, you help clear Dragonmaw banners from the marsh and keep the trade corridors to Menethil Harbor safe from orc raiders.
As an Alliance member, you weaken an old enemy before the Dragonmaw can rebuild the terrible strength they wielded during the Second War.
